title: Nexus StrategyApprovals
description: Response of GET /v1/daemon/strategies/{strategy_id}/approvals — every approval of the strategy in the same total order the applied status read uses to pick `newest_approval`: `candidate_revision` DESC, then `approved_at` DESC, then `approval_id` DESC. `items[0]` is therefore the status read's `newest_approval`, and no client re-sorts or derives newness from a timestamp. The list exists so a client can aim Apply at a superseded approval — the rollback path — instead of holding only the newest.

items.description: Every approval of this strategy, newest first by the total order above. Empty when nothing was approved.

StrategyApproval.title: StrategyApproval
StrategyApproval.description: One approval row, reduced to the keys a client needs to list it and to aim an apply at it.

approval_id.description: Approval identity; the value a client compares with the current apply's and the newest approval's `approval_id`.

content_hash.description: The content hash applying this approval would install; the apply request names this value.

candidate_revision.description: Candidate revision the approval froze. This key, not either timestamp, defines approval newness.

approved_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp of the approval; it orders tied revisions only.
